hero.alt: A grid of posters in historical design styles.

overview.challenge: Study historical design movements as systems to understand, not styles to copy.
overview.solution: Research and thumbnails first (25 for some movements), then refined compositions that reinterpret each reference.
overview.outcome: A nine-poster series. Dada, the Stenberg brothers and Modernism are the strongest directions.
